headline: Short-period SSE at a bad angle — glassy dawn, then cross-on mush.
today: Up to 2.6ft but it's marginal-angle SSE at short period, so it's more chop than shape. Light NW to ENE wind at dawn and morning gives you glass; afternoon SSE goes cross-on and it deteriorates. Fish or groveler on the morning low-to-incoming, don't overthink it.

daysToWatch.note: Marginal angle but a longer-period line touches 10s, and W-to-SW is offshore/cross-off in the morning. Worth a dawn look for the cleaner water.
Prime ESE angle at up to 9.7s — the direction this inlet actually likes — but it's only 1.7ft and winds stay cross-on. Right swell, not enough size.
